name: Kanbayashi Azusa
source:
A female doctor in charge of surgery at St. Louis Hospital, where her father serves as director. She is a perfectionist with a haughty personality and a tendency to despise men.

She wears clothes that clearly show the outline of her body under her white coat to show off her big breasts, but she has a cold attitude toward all male staff.
